_notes: Time factor (offline catch-up) and Horde Alert rules. timeFactor applies only when the player's setting is ON (default OFF). On launch: credit = min(realSecondsAway, maxOfflineCreditHours * 3600); if the device clock went backwards, credit = 0. Credit is simulated in bulk with catchUpStepSeconds steps; no combat ever runs during catch-up and the horde clock does not move. queuesThatProgress = timers that advance during catch-up. productionEfficiency multiplies building output while away (1.0 = same as playing); output still stops at storage caps. Scavenging run rewards wait at the post (not capped until collected). welcomeBackMinAwaySeconds = shortest absence that shows the summary. hordeAlert: on backgrounding (and setting ON), schedule ONE local notification at a seeded-random time inside notifyWindowMinutes after leaving, moved out of quiet hours (local time, 24h). If the app is next opened after that time, one bonus horde (hordes.json bonusHorde) waits at a map edge. Works whether or not the time factor is ON.

hordeAlert.notificationText: A horde has been spotted near the highway. It's waiting for you.
